name: ws-p4-wifi6-dev-kit
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-DEV-KIT
notes: ESP32-P4NRW32 (32 MB PSRAM), 16 MB flash (W25Q128 on the schematic; the wiki says 16 and 32 in different places); the ESP32-C6 companion isn't used. The wiki lists the RJ45 and a PoE module header but has no Ethernet demo; the schematic wires a PHY with the IP101GRI's pinout on IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50) with reset on GPIO51; the PHY part and address 1 are taken from Waveshare's other P4 boards. Pins: Waveshare schematic. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42) on LDO channel 4; supply switch on GPIO45 on by default. Power LED only.
